scope: Separate Cat plans from subjects and award usable house decorations

Each of the nine plans previews a distinct furnishing and grants one copy on first completion.
Place in house opens the existing placement flow; players can also keep the item for later.
Previously completed plans receive their item when loaded. Receipts survive replay, learning reset and save restoration.
Cat-care coins and timer rewards remain unchanged.
